t: Of 1934, of said City and County of San Francisco, does hereby determine and declare that the assessment to be imposed for the said contemplated improvements, respectively, may be paid in three (3) installments…
pl: Paving assessments on Bright and Crane Streets payable in three installments

t: The sum of six hundred ($600) dollars is hereby authorized and directed to be set aside and appropriated out of the boulevard bonds and to be payable to Elizabeth A. McCabe, and Elizabeth A. McCabe, as administratrix of the estate of Patrick J. McCabe…
pl: Elizabeth A. McCabe paid $600 for Bay Shore Boulevard land

t: Denying an application to rezone property located at the easterly side of Crane street and running northerly 100 feet, from First Residential district to Light Industrial district is hereby disapproved.
pl: Light industry refused on Crane Street after the appeal fails

t: The time for hearing the appeal from the decision of the City Planning Commission, denying application to rezone from Second Residential District to Commercial District, property located at the northwest corner of Mariposa and Vermont streets…
pl: Appeal set for December over shops at Mariposa and Vermont streets
